The South African Health Department in conjunction with the Department of International Relations formally invites all nations to an international forum on the HIV/AIDS epidemic in November 2024. Sub-Saharan Africa is one of the most hardest hit regions on the planet, but we also understand fully that this is an is a scourge that affects industrialized nations as much as it does developing industrialized nations and the third world.

While there have been great strides over the past three decades to raise awareness, provide treatment, and educate the population, we must come together under a united banner to regroup our efforts and provide a more aggressive response to this epidemic.

Since this is a global epidemic, we will not bar participation based upon alliances, treaties, pacts or current international disputes. We will, however, request full participation if your nation chooses to attend.

Our agenda will include the following topics:

-Pharmaceutical research and development

-International aid programs to provide treatment options to nations with emerging economies

-How to face social stigma and preconceived notions due to religion, sexual orientation, and familial hegemony

-Providing education to both urban and rural populations across multi-ethnic and cultural lines

-Comparisons and contrasts of effects on first world vs. third world nations

There will also be two days dedicated to an open forum where all attending nations may select a delegate to discuss their nation's position at length. This will be followed by a brief Q&A session after each presentation.

We hope to have a very productive and successful event. Thank you in advance for your consideration and possible participation.
